description: Scaffold the Next.js 14+ project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, App Router, and all necessary dependencies for the BrainFog.mov platform.
steps: Initialize a Next.js 14+ project in /projects/sandbox/empty-repo using create-next-app with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, App Router, and src/ directory. Use --use-npm flag. If create-next-app prompts are an issue, manually scaffold the project.
Install additional dependencies: next-auth (for authentication), lucide-react (for icons), clsx and tailwind-merge (for className utilities), framer-motion (for animations)
Configure Tailwind CSS with a dark theme as default, custom colors for branding (vibrant purple/pink/cyan accent colors on dark backgrounds)
Set up the base layout in src/app/layout.tsx with proper metadata for BrainFog.mov (title, description, favicon placeholder)
Create a utility file src/lib/utils.ts with a cn() className merge helper
Create a basic src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and any custom CSS variables for the brand colors
Update the README.md to describe the BrainFog.mov project
Verify the project builds successfully with npm run build
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
The project has TypeScript configured with strict mode
Tailwind CSS is configured with custom brand colors
All specified dependencies are installed in package.json
